name: OpenAI ChatGPT
description: Industry-leading conversational AI for teaching prompt engineering and AI literacy
detailedInfo: ChatGPT from OpenAI is the most widely adopted AI tool in education. It teaches students how to formulate effective prompts, evaluate AI outputs critically, and understand AI capabilities and limitations.
skillsDeveloped: Prompt engineering, critical thinking, AI literacy

name: Google Teachable Machine
description: Train ML models without coding - from Google Research
detailedInfo: Developed by Google Creative Lab, Teachable Machine democratizes machine learning education by allowing students to train image, audio, and pose models through an intuitive interface.
skillsDeveloped: ML fundamentals, data collection, model training

name: MIT App Inventor
description: Block-based mobile app development from MIT
detailedInfo: MIT App Inventor enables students to create functional Android apps using visual programming. It integrates AI components like image recognition and speech-to-text.
skillsDeveloped: App development, computational thinking, AI integration

name: VEX Robotics
description: Competition-grade robotics platform used in 50+ countries
detailedInfo: VEX Robotics is the world largest robotics competition platform, combining mechanical engineering, programming, and strategic thinking. Used by over 20,000 teams globally.

name: LEGO Education SPIKE
description: Hands-on STEAM learning with programmable robotics
detailedInfo: LEGO Education SPIKE combines the familiar LEGO building system with Python and block-based programming. Ideal for introducing robotics concepts.

name: Kaggle
description: Real-world datasets and competitions from Google
detailedInfo: Kaggle provides access to thousands of datasets and data science competitions. Students can learn by doing and build portfolios with real projects.

name: Tableau Public
detailedInfo: Tableau Public is the industry standard for data visualization. Students learn to tell stories with data and create interactive dashboards.

name: Anthropic Claude
description: Advanced AI assistant with strong reasoning capabilities
detailedInfo: Claude from Anthropic offers extended context windows and strong analytical reasoning, making it excellent for research and complex problem-solving tasks.
skillsDeveloped: Advanced reasoning, research skills, AI literacy
